name: stocks
title: Buy Tokenized Stocks
description: Buy tokenized stocks on Base using only the user’s prepaid Vaaya balance, never the welcome credit or the GitHub credit line. Commands: list (supported token tickers), portfolio (owned stocks and buying power), quote {symbol, amount_cents}, buy {symbol, amount_cents, idempotency_key}, order {order_id}. When the user asks to buy a specified stock and dollar amount, resolve its supported token ticker (Apple = AAPLc) and call buy directly; no activation or additional approval step. amount_cents is the maximum total prepaid spend including provider fees. Use a unique idempotency_key for each intended purchase and reuse it on retries. Query order until confirmed/failed; queued/submitted is not success. Do not increase the user’s spend or retry a failed purchase as a new order without instruction. Ask only for missing or ambiguous purchase details. If prepaid_required or buyingPowerCents is insufficient, offer a $10/$30/$100 prepaid pack: POST /api/v1/topup with pack_cents 1000/3000/10000 and the same account bearer token returns a Stripe Checkout url. With authorization for that pack amount, the user’s Instinct agent can pay the URL in its browser using the card saved in Instinct; otherwise give the URL to the user. Vaaya cannot charge Instinct’s card directly. Do not include card details or tokens in a handoff. Check GET /api/v1/wallet wallet.prepaid_cents, then portfolio buyingPowerCents before resuming the same purchase key. A share purchase alone does not authorize a top-up. Stop on needs_review as well as failed.

command.description: list (supported tickers), portfolio (holdings + buying power), quote, buy, or order (status by id).

symbol.description: Token ticker from list, e.g. AAPLc. Required for quote and buy.

amount_cents.description: Maximum prepaid spend in cents, pool fees included. Required for quote and buy.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intended purchase; reuse it on retries. Required for buy.

order_id.description: Order id returned by buy. Required for order.

stocks.description: list: supported stocks with symbol, name, address, priceUsd and staleness.

id.description: quote/buy/order: quote id or order id.

amountCents.description: Prepaid cents reserved for the purchase.

minimumTokens.description: quote: guaranteed minimum after 50 bps slippage.

status.description: buy/order: queued | approving | ready | submitted | confirmed | failed | needs_review.

chargedCents.description: buy/order: cents actually charged once confirmed.

txHash.description: buy/order: Base transaction hash once broadcast.

buyingPowerCents.description: portfolio: prepaid cents available for stocks.

address.description: portfolio: the user stock wallet on Base.

totalValueUsd.description: portfolio: holdings value at the latest feed price.

holdings.description: portfolio: per-stock tokens, shares, valueUsd and staleness.
